dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds like a tough job.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: It's fine. I don't think so.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Interaction brings color to an otherwise ordinary life, and it helps to make your mind more agile.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: The longer you work here, the more you realize how important this agility is.
